evidence: The amorphous property of TiO2 nanostructures is revealed by XRD and the composition of nanotubes is measured by TEM–EDX. The impurity contents and binding structure of the nanostructures are analyzed by XPS. The morphology of nanotubes was investigated by SEM and TEM. For TEM analysis of dispersed TiO2 nanotubes, AAO membranes were selectively dissolved in 2 M NaOH. Elemental qualitative analysis of single TiO2 nanotube was carried out using EDX coupled with TEM system. Capacitance measurements of AAO and TiO2 nanostructured AAO were performed in two electrode system. The electrolyte consisted of 80 g/L ammonium borate and the capacitance was measured at constant frequency of 120 Hz by LCR meter (GW INSTEK LCR-821).
